harness: Runs save into outputs/ instead of .claude/blog/drafts/ and never touch WordPress. Fixtures are published posts plus one fake research file; the multisite research file and the client name in eval 3's prompt are planted on purpose.

evals.name: php-cve-redo
evals.prompt: the feature image for the PHP CVE post is not right, make me a new one. draft: evals/files/drafts/php-cve-2026-109618-109619.md
evals.expected_output: A 1200x628 card at 2x in the current palette with a short punch line that is not the title, real material from the post (versions, the stopgap settings, the CVE IDs), the ik. badge and ivankristianto.com footer, a one-sentence alt text, and no hand-drawn picture.
expectations: An editable HTML or SVG source is saved in outputs/
A PNG or WebP image is saved in outputs/
Rendered image is 2400x1256 (1200x628 at 2x)
Accent green #2F5D50 appears in the image
Retired terracotta #C2410C does not appear in the image
Image background is drafting white #FCFCFA
Source has no hex colours outside the theme.json palette
Source loads no webfont, gradient or shadow
Footer has the ik. badge and ivankristianto.com, not the full name
Punch line is marked up, 14 words or fewer, and is not the post title
Alt text is saved and is one sentence
No em or en dashes in the image source text or alt text
leak-check.sh exits 0 on source and alt text
Chat reply links outputs with file:/// URLs
[judged] The punch line reads at 500px wide (feed size)
[judged] The card carries real material from the post (code, command output, numbers), and anything sketched is flagged
[judged] No label, icon or text collides or clips at full size
